description.desc_thousand_char: Cincorp International Limited (CIL) is engaged in designing, developing, and producing primary plastic packaging for pharmaceutical, FMCG, and industrial markets. It specializes in the production of HDPE, LDPE, PP and PS containers/bottles using injection blow moulding (IBM) machines. Its facility is located in Noida, NCR. The company exports its products to various countries like the USA, the EU, and more. CIL serves more than 50 customers across India, including FDC Limited, Ind Swift Limited, Cosmas Pharmacls, Bajaj Pharmaceuticals, BACFO Pharmaceuticals, Krauter Healthcare, and Surya Herbal Limited, among others. CIL was incorporated in 2008 and has its registered office located in Delhi.
